benefits.name: VA health care priority groups
benefits.description: 10%+ service-connected ratings may move you into a higher VA health care priority group. Actual placement also depends on income, service history, Medicaid, and other factors. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.

benefits.name: VA home-loan funding fee waiver
benefits.description: You may not have to pay the VA funding fee on a VA-backed or VA direct home loan if you receive VA compensation for a service-connected disability. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.
benefits.source_name: VA Funding Fee and Loan Closing Costs

benefits.name: Veteran Readiness and Employment (Chapter 31)
benefits.description: VR&E may be available if you have a service-connected disability rating of at least 10% and a work limitation or employment barrier. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.
benefits.source_name: Eligibility for Veteran Readiness and Employment

benefits.name: Commissary and exchange access
benefits.description: You may be able to use commissary and exchange privileges if you have a service-connected disability rating and an honorable discharge; a VHIC can be used at checkout. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.
benefits.source_name: Commissary and exchange privileges for Veterans

benefits.name: CHAMPVA for dependents
benefits.description: Spouses, dependent children, and some survivors may qualify for CHAMPVA when the Veteran is permanently and totally disabled from a service-connected disability. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.

benefits.name: Chapter 35 DEA for dependents
benefits.description: Spouses and children may qualify for Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance when the Veteran is permanently and totally disabled from a service-connected disability. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.

benefits.name: Dependents' additional compensation
benefits.description: Additional compensation for dependents is available starting at 30% service-connected disability; the exact amount depends on your family situation. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.

benefits.name: Special Monthly Compensation (SMC)
benefits.description: SMC may be available at different levels for severe service-connected loss or care needs. Exact entitlement varies by condition and level. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with VA.

benefits.name: NPS Access Pass
benefits.description: The Access Pass is a free lifetime pass for U.S. citizens or residents with a permanent disability; it can cover federal recreation entrance and day-use fees. For this directory, it may be available if you have a permanent service-connected disability. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with the provider.

benefits.name: SC property tax exemption
benefits.description: South Carolina property tax exemption on real estate may be available for totally and permanently disabled Veterans; surviving spouses may also qualify. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with the county assessor and SCDVA.

benefits.name: SC hunting and fishing license
benefits.description: South Carolina may provide a free hunting/fishing license to disabled Veterans. Apply through SCDNR and verify renewal rules with the state. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with the provider.

benefits.name: SC disabled-veteran license plates
benefits.description: South Carolina may issue special license plates for disabled Veterans; certain registration fees may still apply. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with SCDMV.

benefits.name: SC state park reduced rate
benefits.description: South Carolina residents who are permanently and totally disabled Veterans may enter state parks at a reduced rate and may qualify for a Palmetto Passport. Some services may cost extra. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with the state park service.

benefits.name: SC tuition waiver for eligible children
benefits.description: South Carolina may waive tuition for qualified children of certain Veterans at state-supported schools; residency and other eligibility rules apply. Programs change - confirm your eligibility with SCDVA and the school.
